Emile Henry has always been committed to French craftsmanship. We remain true to our historic location in Marcigny, deep in the heart of Burgundy, and are proud to contribute to maintaining traditional skills as well as jobs.

Founded in 1850, and located in Marcigny, a small town in the province of Burgundy, France, Emile Henry has established a worldwide reputation for manufacturing the finest quality ceramic ovenware, gourmet cooking products, and bakeware products.
